scope: Post-hoc supplementary development analysis on previously inspected patients, not preregistration or independent validation
feature_policy: Recompute all four features in each robustness condition; full six-channel average reference and original band-density definition; first fraction of chronological blocks before QC, never first fraction of clean blocks
canonical_arithmetic: Verify cache-derived features within numerical tolerance, then preserve frozen baseline contrast floats exactly for canonical models; all alternative conditions recompute four features
failure_policy: No silent exclusions, no imputation; record unsupported conditions and stop on invalid data
influence: Remove each of 41 patients from all original training and test appearances, refit full-feature signed mean and MDCO on retained training patients, retain original fold assignments and both classes; report all 41 results

uncertainty.method: patient-paired exponential Dirichlet weights shared across five OOF appearances and all methods
uncertainty.estimand: mean of 25 within-fold AUCs; equal cohort macro when applicable

stopping_rule: Fixed complete menu, no optimization against outer results; preserve canonical results and report adverse outcomes
output: results/bspc_supplement_v1; refuse overwriting an existing directory
